workflow_name: Student Residence Maintenance Service Request: Broken Tap Repair

required_inputs.prompt: Enter Residence Name, Block, and Room/Bathroom Location
Enter Water Leak Severity (Dripping / SteadyStream / Flooding)

chain.name: WorkGroup 1: Residence Helpdesk Intake & Leak Triage

children.name: Log student maintenance ticket and timestamp in facilities queue
Stage 1A: Student & Location Verification
Verify student_number is registered to the reported residence building
Confirm exact room or communal bathroom location from residence_room
Stage 1B: Water Damage Risk Assessment
SubProcess 1B-1: Emergency Isolation Check
Assess urgency_level to determine if main block stopcock must be shut off
Notify Residence House Parent if active flooding is reported
Stage 2A: Plumber Assignment & Scheduling
Assign ticket to on-duty campus maintenance plumber
Coordinate room access window with student and residence reception
Stage 2B: Plumbing Parts & Tool Preparation
SubProcess 2B-1: Central Stores Requisition
Check out replacement ceramic disc cartridge, washers, and O-rings
Check out complete mixer tap assembly as backup replacement
Collect pipe wrench, PTFE thread seal tape, and basin spanner

chain.name: WorkGroup 3: On-Site Plumbing Repair & Pressure Testing

children.name: Stage 3A: Isolation & Disassembly
Turn off under-basin angle valve and drain residual line pressure
Remove tap handle, shroud, and worn internal valve stem
Stage 3B: Component Replacement & Reassembly
SubProcess 3B-1: Valve Seat & Cartridge Refit
Clean brass valve seat and inspect for scaling or hairline cracks
Install new washer/cartridge with PTFE tape and torque bonnet nut
Reattach tap handle and clean aerator mesh screen
Stage 3C: Live Water Flow & Leak Test
SubProcess 3C-1: Pressure & Seal Verification
Restore water supply at angle valve and purge air from pipe
Test full hot and cold flow and verify zero dripping when closed
Dry surrounding basin and cabinet and check trap for secondary leaks

chain.name: WorkGroup 4: Student Inspection Sign-Off & Ticket Closure

children.name: Stage 4A: Quality Handover & Cost Logging
Record parts used and plumber labour time against residence maintenance budget
SubProcess 4A-1: Resident Confirmation & Notification
Obtain student or residence warden sign-off on completed tap repair
Update ticket status to Completed and send completion email to student
